children: Australian stocks are likely to fall in early trade, with ASX futures down by 1.0% ahead of Thursday's open. That follows losses on Wall Street, where U.S. stocks extended their recent decline as the war in the Middle East continued to escalate and drive up oil prices. The S&P/ASX 200 is already down 1.1% week to date, taking its month-to-date losses to 1.8%.(rhiannon.hoyle@wsj.com; @RhiannonHoyle)
